note: Fish index sourced from real gameplay (Sept 2026). Values are base-range observations — your sell-value upgrades multiply them. Rarities: Common > Uncommon > Rare > Epic > Legendary > Mythical > Secret. Newly sighted species are marked unverified until confirmed by multiple creators.

fish.name: Goldfish
fish.note: The bread-and-butter starter fish. A golden variant exists.

fish.name: Tench
fish.note: Small river fish, ~9 kg. Golden Tench mutation confirmed.

fish.name: Shrimp
fish.note: Tiny but frequent. Giant Shrimp mutations sell for thousands.

fish.name: Crayfish
fish.note: Often confused with Shrimp in the index.

fish.name: Red Snapper
fish.note: Reliable early filler catch.

fish.name: Clownfish
fish.note: Huge Clownfish mutations exist.

fish.name: Betta
fish.note: Colorful starter fish.

fish.name: Koi
fish.note: Small but pretty. Every player catches one early.

fish.name: Bass
fish.note: Slightly heavier than other commons — early rods may struggle.

fish.name: Flying Fish
fish.note: Often your first $200+ catch. Leaps out of the hole.

fish.name: Seahorse
fish.note: Surprisingly good value for its size.

fish.name: Snapper
fish.note: Huge Uncommon Snapper mutations are a known flex.

fish.name: Blue Tang
fish.note: Value scales hard with sell-value upgrades — a mid-game money maker.

fish.name: Sea Dragon
fish.note: Flashy catch, decent early payday.

fish.name: Beluga Whale
fish.note: Looks like a baby seal. Adorable and valuable.

fish.name: Crocodile
fish.note: ~30 kg. Famous for being catchable on weak rods — the classic first 'big' catch.

fish.name: Alligator
fish.note: Why is there an alligator in the hole? Nobody knows. Sell it anyway.

fish.name: Frost Bone
fish.note: Skeletal fish. No special cutscene, but a solid rare.

fish.name: Meat Fish
fish.note: Gets a dramatic catch animation despite being mid-tier. Classic fake-out.

fish.name: Pufferfish
fish.note: Epic tier starts here. Noticeable money jump.

fish.name: Blue Carp
fish.note: Epic Blue Carp is a mid-game cash cow — farm these.

fish.name: Sailfish
fish.note: Fast and flashy.

fish.name: Octopus
fish.note: ~65 kg. Big Rare Octopus mutations confirmed.

fish.name: Starfish
fish.note: Yes, it looks like Patrick. No, you can't catch a SpongeBob.

fish.name: Turtle
fish.note: Steady epic money. Seen in server holes often.

fish.name: Void Ray
fish.note: Night-time epic that pays like a legendary. Prioritize night fishing.

fish.name: Orca
fish.note: ~1.5 tons. Often the first legendary players see.

fish.name: Hammerhead Shark
fish.note: Big payday. Expect a cutscene.

fish.name: Great White Shark
fish.note: Top-tier legendary. One catch can fund a full rod tier.

fish.name: Asian Turtle
fish.note: Weighs half a ton. The night-fishing legend that makes millionaires.

fish.name: Goblin Shark
fish.note: Ugly, rare, expensive.

fish.name: Sawfish
fish.note: Value swings wildly with upgrades — late-game sawfish are nine figures.

fish.name: Sunfish
fish.note: Large Sunfish mutations are end-game jackpots.

fish.name: Nebulous Fin
fish.note: Half a billion base. One of the best non-secret catches in the game.

fish.name: Glass Fish
fish.note: Single sighting in Sept 24, 2026 creator footage: caught with a Royal Rod, sold for ~$475M. The same creator says only three mythics exist — if so, Glass Fish may have rotated in with the Sept 22/24 patches. Unverified until a second sighting.

fish.name: Squid
fish.note: Night exclusive. Squid money adds up fast.

fish.name: Jellyfish
fish.note: Common night catch.

fish.name: Moray Eel
fish.note: Cheap for a night fish, but fills the index.

fish.name: Lionfish
fish.note: Night exclusive, decent value.

fish.name: Ghost Catfish
fish.note: Spooky but common. Easy night-index filler.

fish.name: Glacial Wyrm
fish.note: SECRET #1. Multi-billion payout — confirmed catch. See the Secret Fish guide.

fish.name: Alien
fish.note: SECRET #2. Referenced in gameplay as an ultra-rare luck-based catch. Details still being verified.

fish.name: Orfish
fish.note: A night-exclusive standout that arrives with a cutscene despite being mid-value. Sighted in creator gameplay ($40K) and named in community wikis — one of the fish people specifically go night fishing for.

fish.name: Legendary Toadfish
fish.note: Green, fat and poisoned-looking — a Legendary that lands around the $8M mark in creator gameplay. Named in community wikis alongside Orfish as a standout catch.

fish.name: Swordfish
fish.note: Long-billed billfish. Creators place it above $50K and treat it as a solid mid-game payday — often confused with the Sawfish in the index.

fish.name: Magma Fin Devourer
fish.note: Reported as a third secret: a huge finned catch that arrived with a cutscene and sold for roughly $400M in a single creator video. Only one sighting so far — treat as unconfirmed until more players report it.
